piece_type: TV skin/background (PP-DAN-US-0177) and video (PP-DAN-US-0172), professional and DTC
regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.claim: [Omission] Background and video omit W&Ps for cardiac and arterial vascular occlusive events, tumor lysis syndrome, hemorrhage, fluid retention, embryo-fetal toxicity; video fails to say low blood cell counts are common but also severe. Video: “Ask your doctor about Danziten™ and review the full Prescribing Information, including the Boxed WARNING.”
cases.context: Product with Boxed Warning and multiple W&Ps.
cases.rationale: Omits important risks; PI reference does not mitigate.
cases.check: Rule: diff risk content vs all W&P headings.

cases.claim: [Ordering] “high blood sugar” (Adverse Reactions) presented before “elevated liver enzymes, low blood counts, or pancreatitis” (W&P)
cases.rationale: Risks not presented in order of severity, framing W&P risks as less serious.
cases.check: Rule: risk items must be ordered Boxed Warning → Contraindications → W&P → ARs; flag inversions.

cases.cat: Broadening of indication / omission of material indication information
cases.claim: [Omission] Background suggests Danziten is for adult patients taking Tasigna; video suggests use after intolerance or resistance to any prior therapy
cases.context: PI: Ph+ CML chronic/accelerated phase resistant or intolerant to prior therapy that included imatinib.
cases.rationale: Fails to specify imatinib-containing prior therapy requirement.
cases.check: Rule: indication statement must include all PI qualifiers (prior therapy specifics).
